translationRepairs: The Gannan general Jueluo Shushu led imperial guards south into Guangdong and was defeated by Shang Zhixin's general Yan Ziming; the army retreated to within thirty li of Ganzhou.
The Zhennan General Jueluo Shushu led imperial guards south into Guangdong and was defeated by Shang Zhixin's general Yan Ziming; the army retreated to within thirty li of Ganzhou.
s0017 opens with 鎮南將軍覺羅舒恕; 鎮南 is Zhennan (the title), not 贛南 Gannan. The prior literal conflates the title with the Ganzhou region; Zhennan General restores the correct reading.
When the special erudition examination opened, Wei Xiangju nominated Zishou and Tang Bin to compete.
When the special erudition examination opened, Wei Xiangshu nominated Zishou and Tang Bin to compete.
s0034 names 魏象樞; 樞 is shū, so Wei Xiangshu, not Xiangju. The proposed idiomatic correction fixes a clear given-name misreading without changing sense.
When the Boxue Hongci examination was opened, Wei Xiangju recommended Zishou together with Tang Bin to sit for it.
When the Boxue Hongci examination was opened, Wei Xiangshu recommended Zishou together with Tang Bin to sit for it.
The same Chinese 魏象樞 requires Wei Xiangshu in the literal field. Xiangju misreads 樞; the proposed replacement is accurate.
A man had a stepmother who was wanton and wished also to violate his daughter by the first wife; she refused and was killed.
A commoner had a second wife who was wanton and wished also to violate his daughter by the first wife; she refused and was killed.

s0155 has 民有繼妻素淫，欲並亂前妻女; 繼妻 is the commoner's subsequent wife (stepmother to the first wife's daughter), not the man's stepmother. The prior literal reverses kinship; the proposed second wife restores it.
The emperor sent Minister Zhang Tinglu to investigate; following Mengqiu, conspirators were executed and duped commoners released.
The emperor sent Minister Zhang Tingshu to investigate; following Mengqiu, conspirators were executed and duped commoners released.
s0214 names 尚書張廷樞; 樞 is shū, so Zhang Tingshu, not Tinglu. The proposed idiomatic correction fixes the given-name misreading.
The emperor ordered Minister Zhang Tinglu to investigate; following Mengqiu's proposal those who joined the rebellion were executed and deluded commoners who were enticed were all released.
The emperor ordered Minister Zhang Tingshu to investigate; following Mengqiu's proposal those who joined the rebellion were executed and deluded commoners who were enticed were all released.
Literal likewise misreads 張廷樞 as Tinglu; Tingshu matches 樞 and leaves the rest of the sentence intact.
